p='src/intake.py'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
old=s[s.index('# Some providers'):s.index('class Intake')]
new='''def storage_key(hook: Webhook) -> str:
    # Providers do not all resend the original event id on retry (Harbor sends
    # po_1844 then po_1844.2), but they do resend the Idempotency-Key header, so
    # the full header key is the replay identity. Never truncate it: distinct
    # keys can share a prefix. Scope it by provider, since keys are
    # provider-generated. Fall back to the event id when the header is missing.
    if hook.idempotency_key:
        return f"{hook.provider}:{hook.idempotency_key}"
    return hook.event_id


'''
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
EOF
cat >> tests/test_intake.py <<'EOF'


def test_harbor_retry_with_a_new_event_id_is_not_applied_twice():
    intake = Intake()
    first = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    again = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844.2", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    assert first.applied is True
    assert again.applied is False
    assert again.duplicate is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 18_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 1


def test_keys_sharing_a_prefix_both_settle():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("northwind", "po_1", "8f3c1a9e-aaaa", amount=18_000))
    intake.apply(hook("northwind", "po_2", "8f3c1a9e-bbbb", amount=2_000))
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 20_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 2


def test_same_key_from_different_providers_both_settle():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1", "shared-key", amount=18_000))
    intake.apply(hook("northwind", "po_9", "shared-key", amount=2_000))
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 20_000
EOF
